beats.summary: Michael hosts the Dundies awards, presenting various humorous and awkward awards to office members.

evidence.snippet: Michael: There are a lot of great salesmen in this office, but one of our great salesmen is also a great dad. And a close personal friend of mine, Jim Halpert! Best Dad Dundie!
Michael: Which moves us to, Best Mom Dundie. I guess we all kinda consider her a mom around the office. Meredith Palmer!

beats.summary: Erin publicly breaks up with Gabe during the awards ceremony, causing awkwardness.

evidence.snippet:
Gabe: What?
Erin: I'm not attracted to you. I just, I cringe when you talk.

beats.summary: Deangelo receives the Michael Scott Award for Best Dundies Host and gives a rambling, inappropriate speech.

evidence.snippet: Deangelo: Hold on, hold on one second. I WANNA, I WANNA, I FEEL TRULY BLESSED! UHHH, TO BE WORKING WITH ALL OF YOU!

beats.summary: Michael reflects sadly outside the restaurant on his last Dundies, comparing it unfavorably to a movie franchise.

evidence.snippet: Michael (Outside of the restaurant, obviously sad): So that is how it ends. My last Dundies ever.

beats.summary: Pam and others encourage Michael to continue the Dundies despite the rough night.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Michael, we were thinking maybe we could keep this thing going!
Pam: Let's grab some ice cream, go back to the office, and finish what we started.

notable_quotes.quote: Erin: Gabe, we should break up.
notable_quotes.speaker: Erin
